pages.text: Surrounding land is frozen by the touch of winter, as layers of snow build up all around, and water frozen to ice.
As a $(l:rituals/tiers)$(bold)tier 0$() ritual, there are no additional requirements to complete this ritual.

pages.title: Ritual Specifics
pages.text: $(bold)Duration:$() The ritual lasts for $(ritual:frost_lands/SECONDS/duration) seconds.$(br2)$(bold)Size:$() Ritual area extends $(ritual:frost_lands/radius_x) and $(ritual:frost_lands/radius_z) blocks from the center, and vertically by $(ritual:frost_lands/radius_y) blocks.
